ProfileRef.description:
A local profile is one server origin on one machine. Two profiles never
share a secret, an outbox partition or a daemon instance.
ProfileRef.title: ProfileRef

description:
Forget the local machine identity on sign-out: the daemon checks
`profile` against its own server origin, stops, clears the stored machine
credential and the cached machine id. Nothing is deleted server-side.
title: IdentityForgetRequest
